shared: Moths make free Phial spells and grow the board by casting more spells than any tribe.
differ: What powers each cast: a Recipe you write, Heat stopped at 7, or Phials ripening in hand.

takes.label: Write your own spell
takes.line: Each apprentice adds a line to one shared Recipe, so every Phial grows; the Alchymist steals other tribes' keywords into it.
takes.look_if: to build one spell over the game and pour it anywhere.

takes.label: Count to seven
takes.line: Every spell heats a Lamp that resets each turn: stop at exactly 7 for The Spectacle's double buff, or overshoot to Flare.
takes.look_if: a fresh counting puzzle every turn, buffing your whole board.

takes.label: Ripen and merge
takes.line: Phials grow while you hold them; Cocoon Spinner merges a full hand into one huge dose, Echoed through lenses onto big units.
takes.look_if: to hoard in hand for one giant, planned combo pour.
